name: BepInEx 5 preloader patcher
summary: A patcher dll for BepInEx\patchers that rewrites a game assembly with Mono.Cecil before the game loads it. For changes a plugin cannot make, like adding fields to a game class.
description: A net35 class library that the BepInEx 5 preloader loads from BepInEx\patchers. It gets each target assembly as a Mono.Cecil AssemblyDefinition before Unity loads it and can add or change types, fields and methods. Most mods want the BepInEx 5 plugin template instead; use this one only when the change must exist before the game's code runs.

options.label: Patcher name
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only

options.label: Author
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only
options.help: Goes into the name of the patcher's config file.

options.label: Game folder
options.help: The folder with the game's exe. Only used to copy the built dll into the game.

options.label: Assembly to patch
options.patternHelp: a file name ending in .dll, like Assembly-CSharp.dll
options.help: File name of a dll in <Game>_Data\Managed, with the extension. The game's own code is Assembly-CSharp.dll.

options.label: Mono.Cecil package version
options.help: Match the Mono.Cecil.dll in the game's BepInEx\core folder. BepInEx 5.4 ships 0.10.4.

options.label: Config file
options.help: Settings saved to BepInEx\config that players can edit.

options.label: Copy the dll into the game after each build

next: Open the folder in Visual Studio, Rider or VS Code.
The dll is in bin\Release\net35. With a game folder set it is also copied to BepInEx\patchers in the game.
Start the game and look for the patcher's lines near the top of BepInEx\LogOutput.log.
Your code starts in Patcher.cs, in Patch.
